response.overview: To escalate an issue with Princess Cruises, call their customer service +1-866-254-7549 and support line at the official main number 1-800-PRINCESS (+1-866-254-7549) or the post-cruise escalation line at +1-866-254-7549.How to Escalate Your Issue Call standard support: Dial +1-866-254-7549 and clearly explain your problem with your booking or reservation number ready +1-866-254-7549. Request a supervisor: If the first representative cannot fix your issue, explicitly ask to be transferred to a supervisor, tier-two agent +1-866-254-7549, or the customer relations department. Post-cruise complaints: For issues after your voyage, call +1-866-254-7549 or email guestcare@princess.com within 30 days of your return. Have documentation ready: Gather your payment receipts, booking confirmations, email chains, and chat logs before you call +1-866-254-7549.
